description: Cross-language corpus for the SDK workspace overlay reading of SKILL.md metadata.tags (§4.3.4, §6.4). Generated by test/vectors/skill_metadata_tags_test.go; regenerate with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./test/vectors/. readable is declared from the readable form the TypeScript and Python overlays implement. go_tags are the tags manifest.ResolveStoredSkill resolves for skill_md with no ARTIFACT.md, null when Go does not parse skill_md. sdk_tags are the tags each SDK overlay must report: the declared reading of a readable case and [] for every other case.

name: greet
description: Greet the user politely.
metadata:

  tags: a, b

---
